# 🔁 Chapter 4: SIP

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
How SIPs work, running one, and measuring returns.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [What a SIP Is](/sip/4.1-what-a-sip-is) - Learn how a SIP buys units at each installment's NAV, how it compares to a lumpsum, and what STP and SWP are.
2. [Rupee Cost Averaging, Truth and Myths](/sip/4.2-rupee-cost-averaging-truth-and-myths) - A worked example of rupee cost averaging through SIPs, and when it genuinely helps versus when it does not.
3. [Running a SIP in Practice](/sip/4.3-running-a-sip-in-practice) - Learn how e-mandate and UPI AutoPay work, how to step up, pause or stop a SIP, and what cut-off times mean.
4. [Measuring Returns](/sip/4.4-measuring-returns) - Understand absolute return, CAGR and XIRR, and why different apps can show different return numbers for the same investment.

::: tip 📖 How to read
Go in order. Every new term is explained the first time it appears, and each unit ends with a keywords table.
:::
